Himmat aage badhne ki taakat hona nahi, balki taakat na hone par bhi aage badhna hai.
Alag hone ki himmat karo.
Jo cheez tumhe darati hai, woh karo; phir dar ki maut pakki hai.
Peace ka yield courage hai, weakness nahi.
Sahi reasons ke liye brave bano.
Khamoshi ek jawab hai.
Khamoshi sanctuary hai.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Khamoshi chup hai.
Lagataar koshish hi taqat hai.
Himmat hai storm mein chalna.
Khamoshi man ko darshati hai.
Khamoshi ek gehra jawab hai.
Courage decide karta: fear future decide nahi karega.
Courage—vulnerable hone ki willingness se shuru.
Himmat persistence ki niyyat hai.
Himmat sona hai.
Khamoshi kala hai.
Jeetne ke liye aapko ek hi ladai baar-baar ladni pad sakti hai.
Lagan sab kuch jeet leti hai.
